svg.title: Cohort averages hide different survival and engagement paths
svg.desc: Individual cohort lines show variable contactability and distinct-human response; heavier lines show denominator-weighted historical summaries. Synthetic evaluator truth only (demo-cpc_squeeze-884000, cpc_squeeze). Thin lines are individual weekly acquisition cohorts; the heavy survival curve pools numerator and original-acquired-lead denominator at each age. The lower panel deduplicates each person across a complete 7- or 30-day window; its denominator is the contactable population at window start. The heavier rates pool counts (sum distinct responders / sum eligible), not averages of cohort percentages. Windows are overlapping views of the same synthetic people, not independent evidence. All cohorts are fictional and full windows only.
